stem.text: A constant force $F$, acting on a car of mass $m$, moves the car up a slope through a distance $s$ at constant velocity $v$. The angle of the slope to the horizontal is $\alpha$.

stem.alt: Car drawn at the foot of a slope and again higher up the slope, with a distance s marked along the slope, a force arrow labelled F acting up the slope, and angle α marked at the base.

stem.text: The acceleration of free fall is $g$.
What is the ratio $\dfrac{\text{gravitational potential energy gained by car}}{\text{work done by force }F}$?
